"Pixel Tag Drawer Privacy Policy
Last updated: %1$s
Applies to: Pixel Tag Drawer (com.iwadjp.pixeltagdrawer)

Overview
Pixel Tag Drawer does not send personal or sensitive information to any external server. All processing happens on the device.

Information the app accesses
• The list of launchable apps on the device (app names, package names, etc.): used to display, tag, and filter apps. It is obtained via an ACTION_MAIN / CATEGORY_LAUNCHER query, not the QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES permission that would target every app on the device.
• App usage (optional): to provide the "Recently used", "Launch count", and "Recommended" sort orders, the app aggregates Android UsageStats (last 30 days) and UsageEvents (last 7 days) on the device, but only if access is granted. This permission is granted or revoked manually in Android Settings; the normal runtime permission dialog is not shown. If access is not granted, these sort orders fall back to name order, and every other feature remains available.
• Tags you create, tag assignments, and display settings: stored in an on-device database.

What the app does not do
• It does not request the INTERNET permission and contains no code that connects to an external server.
• It does not include ads, analytics, crash reporting, or telemetry features or SDKs.
• It does not require creating an account or signing in.
• It does not access location, camera, microphone, or contacts.

When data can leave the device
The app itself never sends your data anywhere. Only through your own actions can data leave the device, through either of these two paths:
• Exporting a backup: writes a file containing your tags, assignments, and settings to the destination you choose in Android's standard file picker.
• Copying diagnostic information: the in-app diagnostics view is copied to the clipboard only when you tap "Copy". It may include app names or package names, so review the contents before sharing.

About Android system backup
If system backup (Auto Backup) is enabled in your device's Android settings, local data from this app, including your tags and assignments, may be included in your device backup to your own Google account. This is a mechanism provided by Android/Google, not something this app sends on its own; it is handled under Google's privacy policy.

Data retention and deletion
All data is stored only on the device. You can remove it by deleting tags within the app, clearing the app's storage in Android Settings, or uninstalling the app.

Age
This app is not designed for children.

Changes
If this policy changes in a material way, the "Last updated" date at the top of this document will be updated to reflect that.
